method: Local Python/OpenCV compositing, FFmpeg H.264; no network or paid service
resolution_note: 3840x2160 export resampled from 1672x941 source; no claim of native 4K image detail
encoding: H.264 QP0 lossless coding after RGB to YUV420 conversion; preserves tiny effects without temporal quantization drift
note: The last-to-first transition is checked numerically. Player buffering is separate from media continuity. H.264 quantization can introduce small differences.

effects.planet_atmosphere: Masked periodic cloud-detail advection with fixed shading, rings and silhouette
effects.colony_work_lights: Two textured warm pools sweeping over terrain with occlusion masks
effects.window_reflections: Broad faint glass reflections driven by the work-light phases
effects.coffee_steam: Overlapping advected vapor volumes with continuous birth and dissipation
